description: Source file implementing WGL (Windows OpenGL) surface for D3D texture interop in ANGLE project, including functions for texture info retrieval, surface initialization, locking/unlocking, and resource management.

classes.name: D3DTextureSurfaceWGL
classes.description: WGL implementation of egl::Surface for D3D texture interop, managing D3D textures, locking, unlocking, and resource registration.

methods.name: GetD3D11TextureInfo
methods.description: Retrieves info about a D3D11 texture, including format, size, and device.

methods.name: GetD3D9TextureInfo
methods.description: Retrieves info about a D3D9 texture, including format, size, and device.

methods.name: GetD3DTextureInfo
methods.description: Determines texture info based on buffer type and client buffer, handling both D3D11 and D3D9 textures.

methods.name: D3DTextureSurfaceWGL::initialize
methods.description: Initializes the surface, retrieves texture info, registers D3D object, and creates renderbuffers.

methods.name: D3DTextureSurfaceWGL::makeCurrent
methods.description: Locks the D3D object for rendering.

methods.name: D3DTextureSurfaceWGL::unMakeCurrent
methods.description: Unlocks the D3D object after rendering.

methods.name: D3DTextureSurfaceWGL::bindTexImage
methods.description: Binds a texture to the surface, registering and locking the D3D object.

methods.name: D3DTextureSurfaceWGL::releaseTexImage
methods.description: Releases the bound texture, unlocking and unregistering the D3D object.
